name: Quality HVAC by Fibid

Note an attribution gap exists: paid channels show 6 leads at $270.71 CPL, while GHL CRM recorded 40 won opportunities out of 522 created, and these figures are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: GBP organic collapse and overdue blockers now outweigh paid efficiency as the core risk.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2026-07-31 booking bot); intake owner still unconfirmed — scale-up gate remains locked per SOW.
CPL rose 8.23% 7d/7d to $270.71 on only 6 paid leads in 28 days; 3-day lead count (Sep 10–12) is 0 vs 1 prior 3 days — efficiency deteriorating.
GBP 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' shows 0 calls on 195 impressions over 28 days (0% call rate); last 3 days show 0 GBP actions, down from ~4/day prior week.
GHL records 522 opportunities created vs 6 paid-tracked leads in 28 days — unreconciled gap of 516 contacts; intake leak or attribution break, not an ads problem.
Google Ads spend dropped 42.21% 7d/7d; Sep 10–12 average is $14.44/day vs $58/day prior 3 days — throttle appears uncontrolled, not intentional pacing.

suggestions.text: Audit 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP listing for suspension or CTA suppression; 0 calls on 195 impressions is a broken profile, not low demand.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP profile recorded 0 calls across 195 impressions over 28 days (0% call rate), and the last 3 days show 0 GBP actions site-wide. Log into the GBP dashboard and check for a suspended state, a missing or suppressed call button, or a category mismatch. Success is confirmed when call rate reaches at least 1% within 7 days of the fix — re-check by 2026-09-20.

suggestions.text: Reconcile 522 GHL opportunities vs 6 paid leads; identify if intake seat vacancy (post-Vivian 7/7) is swallowing inbound contacts unworked.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 522 opportunities created against only 6 leads tracked by paid channels in the same 28-day window — a gap of 516 contacts with no clear source mapping. Confirm who owns the GHL intake seat following Vivian's departure on 7/7, and audit the pipeline stage distribution to see if contacts are stalling at first contact. Success is a documented source breakdown for the 522 contacts and a named intake owner confirmed by 2026-09-20.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Ads daily spend: Sep 10–12 averaged $14.44/day vs $58/day prior 3 days — confirm throttle is intentional before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spend collapsed to an average of $14.44/day over Sep 10–12, down from roughly $58/day in the prior 3-day window, a 42% 7d/7d drop. Do not adjust budgets until the intake owner is confirmed (SOW gate per F1). Verify with Nacer whether this is a deliberate throttle or a billing/pacing issue. Re-check on 2026-09-16 — if spend has not recovered to ~$40/day and the throttle is unintentional, escalate to the buyer for a budget correction.
